description_en: Queries the list of user groups that a user has joined
description_zh: 获取用户加入的用户组列表
name: ListUserGroupsForUser

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host instance.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.
For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The page number for a paged query. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定分页查询时，当前页的页码。默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries per page for a paged query.  
The maximum value of PageSize is 100. The default number of entries per page is 20. If PageSize is left empty, 20 entries are returned by default.
Do not leave PageSize empty
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。  
PageSize参数最大取值为100。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The name of the user group to query. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的用户组名称。模糊查询
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to disable paging. Valid values:

true: Disables paging and returns all data.

false: Enables paging and returns the number of user groups specified by PageSize
parameters.help_zh:
指定是否分页查询。取值：

true：不分页，获取全部数据。

false：分页获取数据，每次获取PageSize取值数量的用户组
parameters.name: paging_off

Count.description_en: The total number of user groups returned

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Comment.description_en: The remarks of the user group

ProjectId.description_en: The ID of the project to which the user group belongs

ProjectName.description_en: The name of the project to which the user group belongs
ProjectName.description_zh: 用户组所属项目的名称

UserGroupId.description_en: The ID of the user group

UserGroupName.description_en: The name of the user group
